The residents of Gokuldham Society—including Bhide, Dr. Hathi, Sodhi, Bagha & Natu Kaka, Taarak Mehta, Popatlal, and Babita & Iyer—receive personalized, anonymous messages and gifts (such as a cake, a DVD, an email, money, and cards) instructing everyone to dress up in their best clothes and gather in the society compound at 8:30 AM for a big surprise.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
